stemMd: Which is equivalent to “It is not true that both the file is complete and the file is signed”?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The file is incomplete and unsigned.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The file is incomplete or unsigned, or both.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The file is incomplete and signed only.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The file is complete or signed.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The file is complete and unsigned only.

explanationMd: By De Morgan’s law, not(P and Q) means not P or not Q. At least one condition fails, and both may fail. The statement does not identify which part is missing.

distractorRationale.a: That is stronger than negating the conjunction.
distractorRationale.d: This can hold even when both are true, contrary to the original.
distractorRationale.e: This selects only one of several permitted cases.
distractorRationale.c: This also selects just one permitted case.
